title: Veil-rays at Hamal Crystal Bloom; verdigris curd sold at Node Beta
note: Seven kills in 33 minutes with a Pulse Laser I (2026-11-15). A carcass holds 1 or 2 curd. Curd bids: 330 cr. The first measured run is too high: its 9 curd included carcasses an earlier, unrecorded hunt had left here. The clean run at GSC-0027 gave about 4,200 cr per ship-hour. The herd read 0 at 17:17 UTC after our hunts. Ranched from 2026-11-15 17:40 UTC: no hunt below four animals and four kills a run, until data/wildlife/history.jsonl shows how fast the herd regrows. Sold at Node Beta: Node Gamma's bid of 50 units was down to 13.
